correctness.rationale: Reran both artifacts: verify_minor.py -> VERIFY_MINOR_OK, recovery_test.py -> RECOVERY_OK. M3 entries as logged verified entry-by-entry via two independent q-binomial constructions (q-factorial division and Gaussian recurrence qb_rec, agreement asserted in-script). Determinant det(M3)=q^6+2q^5+3q^4+2q^3+2q^2+q=q*S3 re-derived (1*((q+1)*E22-q^3) expansion matches) and S3(1)=11 matches DLMF 26.12.15 unrefined CSTCPP n=3 count; unrefined dets [1,2,11,170] independently recomputed from integer matrix binom(i+j,2j-i). ZZ-irreducibility of S3 (singleton factor_list, degree 5) and Q9 (singleton, degree 9) confirmed by rerun plus independent sympy factor_list check. Sign-lemma values S3(-1)=-1, S3(0)=1, Q9(-1)=-7 verified; logic is sound: each q-integer [n]_{-1} is 1 (n odd) or 0 (n even), so a pure product of q-integers is >=0 at q=-1, forbidding S3; constant term 1 excludes a q-power prefactor escape. Non-reciprocity ([1,2,2,3,2,1] vs reverse) verified and correctly excludes reciprocal q-integer products. Prime specialization S3(2)=101 verified (sympy.isprime). D4 factorization S=(q+1)[5]_q Q9 verified independently (div*Q9-S=0, remainder 0; full factor_list splits exactly as claimed). Naive-product mismatches and q=2 cross-checks (D4(2)=2069808, S(2)=129363) replay. Report honestly separates proved polynomial/factorization facts from unclaimed items (no general-n theorem, weighting scope standard+8 shifts, Phi bijection not pursued as moot). The label 'standard area-weighted CSTCPP LGV matrix' is a stipulated definition of E_ij within the report (q=1 specialization validated); no false bijection proof is claimed.

value.rationale: Ordinary full value standard for EMERGENT_FINDING (no presumption). The headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a pre-motivated natural object: the CSTCPP LGV matrix and its leading-principal-minor/4x4 determinants were fixed by the admitted target/fallback before computation; the values (S3, Q9) were not known or mechanically implied by unrefined counts; a future researcher searching CSTCPP LGV data, q-CSTCPP minor values, or telescoping obstructions can reuse the explicit logged entries plus the pinpointed non-product boundary. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, or unexplained enumeration: dual-path replayable proofs, q=1 DLMF consistency, four independent anti-product criteria, naive-RHS mismatch equalities, and 8-shift robustness. Scope is natural (even 2n box required for complementation; leading principal minor is the fallback's own largest replayable telescoping step), honestly limited (no general-n claim), and independent of the still-open full identity. Meets the narrow-exact-datum rule: motivated object+invariant, unknown value, retrievable precise fact.
